email.subject: Trusty Pros Plumbing: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I looked at Trusty Pros Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call link, so mobile visitors searching for a plumber in Harbor Falls can't tap to call you, they have to copy the number first. And there's no way to book or request service online, so anyone browsing after hours just leaves.

The title tag is also weak for search, and the footer still shows an old date, both worth a quick fix.

Happy to walk you through all of it in a free 10-minute call, no pitch, just what I'd fix first.

Alex
Northlight Web
